* Illustrated dimensions and targets are not homologated specifications. Confirm structural limits, vehicle range, speeds, loading, battery, safety and regulatory approval before ordering.

Is Fortuna Cargo available to order?

Fortuna Cargo is presented as a product concept. Submit an enquiry to discuss the development timeline, prototype status, production, and potential availability.

What cargo load can it carry?

The usable payload and load certification are still to be validated through engineering and field testing. Please do not treat the concept images as a certified load rating.

What about range and charging?

Final battery capacity, real-world range, charging time, and powertrain information have not been confirmed. TriChokro can provide the latest engineering updates on enquiry.

Are the dimensions final?

No. The 15 × 5 × 6 ft dimensions are illustrated in the original concept artwork. Final dimensions and homologation may change.
